item.title: Best Time to Visit Japan for Food Lovers 2026
item.description: Best Time to Visit Japan for Food Lovers: A Season-by-Season Guide to Regional Cuisine Japan is a country that eats with the calendar. Walk into any restaurant in any prefecture on any given week, and the menu will reflect exactly what the earth, sea, and mountains are offering at that precise moment. This is a nation where chefs change their dishes not just by season, but by micro-season — where the arrival of bamboo shoots in April or the first sanma (Pacific saury) in September is front-page news.
